subject: differences in coefficient magnitudes between Process and lavaan

messages.author: f2ed062db2c08067
messages.subject: differences in coefficient magnitudes between Process and lavaan
parts:
HI

I have a question regarding apparent differences in coefficient magnitudes when I evaluated a mediation model using Preacher and Hayes' SPSS Process Macro versus evaluating it using SEM with the R lavaan package.

 Standardized coefficients were identical between Process and lavaan, but unstandardized coefficients were not.

 Can anyone suggest why that would be the case? For example, is this a consequence of using different parameter estimation methods, namely, OLS (in Process) vs ML (in lavaan)?

We need you to chare more information, like the model, information about the data, etc

A possibility is that you have some missing data, and OLS would use a deletion method, and ML would use FIML. But this is just guessing
